description: This PHP class defines filter parameters for searching languages within the OrangeHRM system, extending a base filter class and specifying allowed sorting fields and default sort behavior.

classes.name: LanguageSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that specifies filtering and sorting options for language search operations in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LanguageSearchFilterParams object with a default sort field 'l.name'.
